name: Crazed Survivor

text.trigger: A survivor finishes a search at a location outside the colony.
text.vignette: A collapsed lean-to rattles and a gaunt woman bursts from it with a length of rebar and nothing in her eyes that you can reason with. She is guarding a stash under the planks.

options.fight-her: Put her down and take her stash: add 3 food, and roll for exposure twice on the searching survivor.
options.run: Back away and give her the ground. Nothing happens.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #67; the exposure rolls fall on the acting survivor (the printed card lets the player choose any survivor at a non-colony location)
